units.source_text: 明石姬所居的西北一区中，北部隔分，建造仓库。

en.t: In the northwestern section where the Akashi lady lived, the northern part was partitioned off and storehouses were built.

units.source_text: 隔垣旁边种着苦竹和茂盛的苍松。

en.t: Beside the dividing fence grew bitter bamboo and luxuriant green pines.

units.source_text: 一切布置都适宜于观赏雪景。

en.t: Everything had been arranged to be well suited for admiring snowy scenery.

units.source_text: 秋尽冬初之时，篱菊傲霜，色彩斑斓夺目，

en.t: When autumn was ending and winter was just beginning, the chrysanthemums by the fence defied the frost, their brilliant colors dazzling the eye,

units.source_text: 柞林红艳，仿佛傲然独步。

en.t: and the oak grove glowed a vivid red, as though standing proudly apart from all else.

units.source_text: 此外又移植种种不知名称的深山乔木，枝叶葱茏可爱。

en.t: In addition, various tall trees from deep in the mountains, whose names were unknown, had been transplanted there, their branches and leaves lush and charming.
